meta.title: Devlog: November 8, 2026 - November 15, 2026
meta.description: a redesigned blog, stronger chat attention controls, and ongoing onboarding work across this week's projects.

bullets.text: continued the onboarding and screen time presentation rebuild, including faster mascot narration and a more dramatic usage reveal, with device review still pending.
expanded coverage around onboarding and screen time flows while continuing broader interface work.

summary.text: i spent a lot of this week getting the main onboarding experience into shape. the source work is there, but i still need to see how it actually feels on a device before calling it done.

bullets.text: published a screen time debugging article and improved blog discovery with crawlable pages, search metadata, and a sitemap.
refined article reading pages, related-post navigation, photo controls, and dark-mode browser branding.
refreshed the site with a notebook-inspired visual system and added blog search, multi-tag filtering, result counts, and empty states.
replaced the fixed homepage instagram card with a feed that can show new artwork without a site edit.

summary.text: the site got a slightly unreasonable amount of attention this week, which is probably appropriate for a personal website. it should now be easier to browse, search, and keep current without treating every new post like a small migration.

bullets.text: expanded the red status category to cover chats that need attention, including stopped work and completed replies that still need a response.
added ways to acknowledge attention from the dashboard, preserve those acknowledgments across restarts, and keep saved chats available for later review.
added compatibility controls and reporting for newer local integration versions, with warnings and validation when status data cannot be safely used.

summary.text: i made stoplight a little less naggy and a little more honest about what needs attention. the compatibility work is also there to make future updates less of a mystery box.
